title: Swathi murder case
narrative: FIR — Swathi murder case, Nungambakkam railway station, Chennai, Tamil Nadu. On 24 June 2016, S. Swathi, a 24-year-old Infosys software engineer, was stabbed to death with a sickle at the Nungambakkam railway station while waiting for a train to her office. The attacker, P. Ramkumar, who had stalked her, fled the scene. Ramkumar was arrested at Tirunelveli on 1 July 2016. He died in custody at Puzhal central prison on 18 September 2016 in circumstances the police described as suicide by electrocution.
